title: biatec_payment authorization detail
description: RFC 9396 authorization_details object of a payment a relying party asks the user to confirm (protocol 1.2, spec section 3.3). The relying party's members are untrusted text: besides this schema, every string obeys the text rules of spec section 15 (relying-party profile), the IBAN's mod-97 check digits are right and `execution_date` is a real calendar date; a verifier checks those (`isValidRelyingPartyDetails` in scripts/lib.mjs). `origin` is added by Biatec OIDC when it has one, never by the relying party.

amount.description: Decimal string, at most two decimals, greater than zero. Never a JSON number.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code: three upper-case letters.

iban.description: Electronic form: upper case, no spaces. The mod-97 check digits are validated by the verifier.

scheme.description: The scheme the identification is in, for example BBAN or SORTCODE.

execution_date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date; a verifier checks that it exists.

origin.description: Added by Biatec OIDC when it has one, as the relying party reported it; part of the hashed object.
